description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector class, which manages collection, organization, and formatting of errors encountered during HTML purification, including error reporting, structuring, and HTML output generation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector
classes.description: A class that collects and manages error messages for the HTML Purifier library, providing methods for error reporting, structuring, and formatted output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error collector with a given context, setting up locale, current error stack, and context references.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Records an error message with severity and message text, along with contextual token and attribute information, and stores it in the error structure.

methods.name: getRaw
methods.description: Retrieves the raw collected error data for custom formatting or processing.

methods.name: getHTMLFormatted
methods.description: Generates an HTML formatted string of the errors for display, including error severity, location, and message.

methods.name: _renderStruct
methods.description: Recursively renders error structures into HTML strings for visual display.
